headline: A 2017 executive order created a presidential advisory commission focused on election integrity.
what_it_does: This order set up a new Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity. As an advisory group, its role was to study issues and give advice to the President, not to make binding rules. No summary was provided, so details about the commission's members, specific tasks, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: The commission's focus on election integrity relates to how federal elections are run, though an advisory body does not itself change voting rules.
Officials who run elections may have been involved in or affected by the commission's study of election processes.
